explore.heading: WELCOME TO THE MOTHERSHIP
explore.intro: A sanctuary for live music, club culture and creative events. Explore the room, click the venue itself, or jump straight to the information you need.

hire.heading: HIRE
hire.intro: A flexible, fully equipped venue for live music, club nights, private events and creative projects.

production.heading: PRODUCTION
production.intro: Sound, lighting, visuals, stage specs and backline are grouped into one production chapter — with the FOH booth and stage acting as the physical entry points in the walkthrough.

past.heading: WHAT WE'VE DONE
past.intro: A visual archive instead of a long list: memorable moments, touring artists, club nights and live performances that show the scale and range of the room.

blocks.body:
* Full-length wall mirror
* Seating for 10 guests
* Mini fridge & freezer with ice
* Private toilet
* Secure entry
* Tea & coffee facilities
* Refreshment area
* Bottled water, Soft drinks
* Multiple power points
* Dimmable lighting
* Separate Wi-Fi access

blocks.title: PRODUCTION MANAGER
blocks.body: Patrick Hawkins: pat@themothership.co.nz

blocks.title: CAPACITY + HOURS
blocks.body: Full capacity: 400+

blocks.title: LOCATION, HOURS, & LICENCE
blocks.body:
Address: 3/13 Shortland Street, Auckland CBD

Operating hours:  Mon-Sun, 4pm-4am

Licence: Supervised until 10pm

Age restriction: 18+

blocks.title: PARKING & LOAD-IN
blocks.body:
Load-in / out: Loading zones outside front main entrance.

Loading Ramp: Two doors down

Street parking: Surrounding pay & display street parking

Parking buildings: Wilson (Shortland Street), AT carpark (Victoria Street)

blocks.title: ACCESSIBILITY
blocks.body:
Our building features a step-free entrance and a ramp leading directly inside, allowing full physical access to the venue. While our Ladies restroom is on ground level with no steps, they do not fully meet the technical legal layout requirements for a certified accessible toilet (such as specific turning radiuses or grab rail configurations).

Our team is fully committed to making your night as seamless as possible. We are always on hand to assist with entry, hold doors, clear paths, or help ensure you have smooth access to the facilities whenever you need it.

If you have specific questions about our layout or want to chat about how we can support your visit, please reach out to us

blocks.title: STAGE
blocks.body:
Stage width × depth × height: WIDTH: 5.44 m (17.8 ft) DEPTH: 4.9 m (16 ft) CLEARANCE: 2.2 m (7.2 ft)

Stage to ceiling height: 2.20m

Stage surface: Timber structure, black carpet finish

Dimensioned stage plan: https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/search?q=stage

blocks.title: GREEN ROOM
blocks.body:
Artist toilet / bathroom location: Private access inside green room

Green Room 1 facilities: Mirror - full length (wall), seating for 10 guests, floor fan, mini fridge, food area counter space, freezer with ice, private toilet, private and secure entry, kettle, tea, coffee, cutlery, plates, glassware options, standard toiletries & refreshment area, chopping board, platters, ice bucket, bottled water, redbull, soft drinks, private bar, multiple power points, phone & laptop charging station (with additional cords and adapters), wristbands, rubbish bins, dimmable lighting, seperate wifi access

Green Room 2 location / facilities: Located next to the main green room. A smaller basic area with minimal seating, power points, mini fridge, ice bucket, secure lockable entry, (can arrange a second private toilet if needed)

Additional dressing room(s): Depending on event size and preferences, we can arrange for the side of the side to be a comununal green room with side of stage access points. However this limits private toilet access and lockable entry.
